summary: Cropido backend tested end-to-end via public URL. 32/33 pytest cases pass (97%). All auth flows (register/login/me/OTP 123456/forgot-password dev_code), dashboard aggregate, marketplace + cart + orders, crop listings, equipment bookings, service bookings, community posts + like toggle, knowledge, businesses, notifications (seeds on first call), subscriptions (4 plans + upgrade to pro_farmer + user record updated), payments, and MongoDB _id exclusion all pass. Only failure: POST /api/ai/chat — Claude Sonnet 4.5 call fails at Emergent LLM gateway with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. This is an infrastructure/quota issue on the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, not a code bug — the endpoint code is correctly wired (session_id, multi-turn context, image_base64 via ImageContent, language switching, message persistence, graceful fallback returning 200 with apology string).

critical.issue: Claude Sonnet 4.5 requests fail at Emergent LLM gateway: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (sk-emergent-68c22C17a94400b8a7) in /app/backend/.env has zero max budget so every completion is rejected. Endpoint still returns HTTP 200 with an apology reply because of the broad try/except in server.py:769 — so it silently degrades. Requires a valid/funded EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from the user. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:757-771

minor.issue: When LLM call fails, endpoint returns 200 with reply='I apologize, I'm having trouble responding right now. (…)' — this masks real failures from the client. Consider returning 502/503 with an error payload so the UI can distinguish real replies from fallbacks.

Demo user demo@cropido.app / demo1234 is NOT seeded by seed_data(). Test infra registered it once, but on a fresh MongoDB the credential in /app/memory/test_credentials.md would not exist. Consider seeding the demo user in server.py startup for consistency.

action_items: Fix EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget in Emergent dashboard OR provide a new funded key — /api/ai/chat currently returns fallback apology for every request. Frontend AI Assistant screen will look broken.
Optionally seed the demo@cropido.app / demo1234 user inside seed_data() so credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md work out-of-the-box after a DB wipe.
Optionally return non-200 status on AI failures so client can differentiate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1127 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, marketplace, community, ai, subs) for maintainability.
All Mongo queries correctly project out _id — verified via recursive check in tests.
AI chat has broad try/except that swallows all LLM errors and returns 200 — good for UX but hides infra issues from monitoring.
PLANS list is fine as-is (constant); subscribe endpoint correctly upserts user.subscription and inserts payment record.
OTP is hard-coded to 123456 (documented MVP behavior, matches test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates a throwaway TEST_<uuid>@cropido.app user for register-flow test and registers demo@cropido.app if not present. Community post + crop listing + equipment/service bookings + orders created with TEST_ prefix or via demo user — safe test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_cropido_backend.py after EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is refreshed. All 32 other tests are stable and idempotent — they can be re-run without cleanup. Base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (already set). The MOCKED Stripe flow is validated (subscribe→user.subscription updated + payment record created + listable via /api/payments).
rca_of_issue: AI chat failure RCA: Backend correctly calls emergentintegrations.LlmChat with model 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. LiteLLM routes through Emergent's OpenAI-compatible gateway, which responds HTTP 400 with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' — meaning the key exists but has Max budget=0. Reproduction: POST /api/ai/chat with any auth'd payload — reply string always starts with 'I apologize, I'm having trouble…'. Mitigation: (a) top up / re-issue EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, (b) verify by re-running TestAI in the pytest suite.
